_about: Public-domain Walter Farquhar Hook (1798-1875), Vicar of Leeds and Dean of Chichester, for the Word Hoard: Lives of the Archbishops of Canterbury (London: Bentley, 1860-1875, eleven volumes) and A Church Dictionary (1842, and the seventh edition of 1854 from Project Gutenberg), from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 35 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
